title: 5-Day Kenya Safari in the Maasai Mara
content:
Maasai Mara Reserve would have to be the number one wilderness travel destination in Africa. It's home to the Great Wildebeest Migration where 2 million strong wildebeest and zebra migrate into the reserve following the rains. No wildlife spectacle rivals this.

But, outside of this seasonal spectacle, this park hosts an abundance of predators and plains game all year round. Here you will see real Africa. Lions, leopard, cheetah, elephants, zebra, giraffe, hippo… there is a diverse array of wild animals in Maasai Mara. Your 5 day safari is focused entirely on finding the best wildlife sightings within this Reserve. No two days are the same.
testimonial: The range of animals and birds we saw over the 5 days had to be seen to be believed.

days.title: Nairobi – Maasai Mara
days.description:
We depart Nairobi after breakfast and make our way to the world famous Maasai Mara Reserve. We’ll make a stop along the way at the viewing point over looking the expansive Great Rift Valley.

Our next break is in Narok for a comfort stop/coffee before our final leg to the Reserve. We will arrive at our lodge for a sumptuous lunch before time to relax for the afternoon. You might want a dip in the pool or sit in the shade with a good book.

At 4pm we head off on our first game drive into the park to seek out lions, leopard, cheetah, elephants or anything out there that wants to be seen. As the sun sets, we’ll arrive back at our lodge for hot showers and dinner.

Later, lay your head on your pillow and wait for the sounds of lions calling their pride or hyenas cackling as you drift off to sleep. Lala vizuri!

days.title: Maasai Mara Reserve
days.description:
Each day we depart the lodge after our yummy breakfast and spend a full day of safari game viewing. We will go where the best wildlife sightings are and explore different areas as we go.

There is no set plan as this is an uncharted adventure. We’ll get you where you need to be on any given day depending on what is happening. And, if you have a special animal you really would like to see, we’ll do our very best to find it for you.
						
As the day progresses, we stop under a shady tree for morning tea, a packed picnic lunch and then afternoon tea later as we wind down our exploring before heading back to our lodge in the early evening.

days.title: Maasai Mara – Nairobi
days.description: The time has come to leave and make our way back to the city life. We’ll make our comfort stop in Narok as we go and arrive back in Nairobi for cafe lunch. You’ll then be taken back to your post safari accommodation for a well earned siesta.

title: 7-Day Kenya Safari Package
content: Our 7 day package gives a taste of Kenya for those who don't have the luxury of time. There's still a large concentration of birds and animals though. Perhaps you're on a business trip with some days spare? Or maybe a local who hasn't seen the country or been to Maasai Mara? Let us show you!
testimonial: What impressed me most about travelling in Kenya with Robyn is how capable and meticulous she is at organising safari trips and how informed she is about African wildlife and the various national parks that are on her itinerary.

days.title: Nairobi – Elementaita
days.description:
After breakfast we leave Nairobi and make our way towards Lake Elementaita. We will make a brief stop at the escarpment overlooking the majestic Great Rift Valley.

We will arrive at Elementaita in time for lunch and your afternoon can be spent relaxing. There’s a pool overlooking the expanse of the lake or you may feel like a massage. Pelicans and flamingos go about their daily hustle right outside your room. Early mornings are a good time to catch the flamingos flying in. Enjoy!

days.title: Nakuru National Park
days.description:
We head off after breakfast, with our picnic lunch, to do a full day game drive in Nakuru National Park. This park is renowned for having over 400 bird species. Lions and leopard live here too and hunt out buffalo and zebra. Both black and white rhino can be seen along with the Rothschild giraffe. The only park where this giraffe can be seen in the wild.

We’ll head back to Elementaita in the late afternoon so you can relax before dinner with a cold beverage overlooking the beautiful lake.

days.title: Elementaita – Maasai Mara
days.description:
We’ll leave the lake shore this morning and head off to the famous Maasai Mara Reserve arriving for lunch at our lodge. It’s then chill out time before our 4pm game drive. We’ll head out into the park and see what we can find... maybe a pride of lions or a leopard eyeing up a gazelle? 

As the sun dips deeper on to the horizon we’ll make our way inside the lodge grounds for our evening relaxation. There’s time for a hot shower and a cold vino before dinner before tucking up in bed to listen to the sounds of the wild. Good night!

days.title: Maasai Mara
days.description:
Each day is spent full day game driving. After a hearty breakfast to keep us going, we’ll explore the wonders of this park seeking out the best wildlife sightings for you. Each day is different and we’ll explore a different area each time.

Our prime objective is to find the animals for you to enjoy. We’ll get in the best position possible for great photos without encroaching on the animals comfort and safety. We’ll make this your ultimate safari experience!

At the end of each day it’s back to the lodge to chill out and remember the magic of your discovery.

days.title: Maasai Mara – Nairobi
days.description: We bid farewell to our home for the past few days and head back to the bustle of the city. We’ll stop briefly in Narok to stretch our legs and have a comfort stop over coffee. A welcome cafe lunch ends our safari before dropping you back at your post safari accommodation.

title: 10-Day Kenya Safari Package
content: Our 10 Day Package begins with full on exposure to bird life. Lake Naivasha, Lake Elementaita and Lake Nakuru are abundant with so many species of birds. A highlight, of course, being flamingos. The second part is all about the animals. The big cats; lions, leopards and cheetahs. The elephants and buffalos. Giraffes and gazelles. Are you ready to explore?
testimonial: I gained an appreciation for the ‘law of nature’ within the animal kingdom, and a respect for the people that I met along the way.

days.title: Nairobi – Ol Pejeta
days.description: We leave Nairobi after breakfast and make our way northward to the Ol Pejeta Conservancy where we arrive for lunch. Time then to relax before an afternoon game drive at 4pm. There’s a waterhole right outside your room where an abundance of animals gather to drink. Even the rhinos! Here is the only place where you can do an optional night game drive.

days.title: Ol Pejeta – Aberdares
days.description:
After breakfast we make our way to the Aberdares. Our lunch today will be at the Aberdare Country Club; a sister to the lodge where we will stay overnight. We will take with us an overnight bag only. Our main luggage will be held in locked storage at the Country Club until our return tomorrow morning.

We board a bus at 2.30pm which takes us 45 min to our accommodation within the Aberdare National Park. Here we will observe the wildlife at close range from one of four viewing decks or a cosy lounge chair. There is a dedicated photo hide on the lower deck where you are able to take close up uninhibited photography.

days.title: Aberdares – Elementaita
days.description:
We leave the Ark Lodge at 8am on the bus and drive out of the park and back to Aberdare Country Club. If we get lucky and see animals before exiting the park we will make a stop. Leopards are often seen at this time.

At ACC we collect our main luggage and get on our way to our next destination. Along the way we stop at the Equator for a water demonstration. Morning tea stop is at Thompson Falls (named after the explorer who discovered the Aberdare Mountains and named them after his employer, Lord Aberdare; and who has the Thompson gazelle named after him). Arrive at Lake Elementaita for lunch. Afternoon to relax and take in the view and birdlife.

title: 14-Day Kenya Safari — Including the Northern White Rhinos
content: So you want a bit more than a few days on safari? You're wanting to see more of the country? Then look no further than our two week adventure. There's loads to see here and a super special treat visiting the only two remaining Northern White Rhinos on this Earth. Jump on board and let's go see what wants to be seen.
testimonial: A highlight was seeing 100–200 elephants crossing a river, then lingering around our van.

days.title: Nairobi – Ol Pejeta
days.description: We​​ leave ​​Nairobi ​​after​​ breakfast ​​and ​​make ​​our ​​way​​ northward​ ​to ​​the ​​Ol ​​Pejeta Conservancy ​​where​ ​we​ ​arrive ​for ​​lunch. ​​Time ​​then ​​to ​​relax​​ before ​​an ​​afternoon​​ game drive at 4pm.​ ​There’s a waterhole right outside your room where an abundance of animals gather to drink. Even the rhinos! Here​​ is ​​the ​​only​​ place ​​where ​​you​ ​can ​​do ​​an​ ​​optional ​​​​​night ​​game ​​drive.

days.title: Ol Pejeta
days.description: After ​​breakfast ​​we head off on a morning game drive looking for rhino, elephant, lions or whatever wants to be seen. You have the opportunity to visit Jane Goodall's chimpanzee sanctuary if you wish. Lunch ​​and ​​afternoon​​ to​​ relax ​​before ​​another ​​afternoon game​ ​drive. ​​There are 32 individual wild dogs here and you might get lucky enough to spot them hunting.

days.title: Ol Pejeta – Samburu
days.description:
It’s​​ a ​​transit ​​day ​​to ​​Samburu ​​on ​​good,​​ easy ​​roads.​​ We ​​check ​​in ​​at ​​the ​​park ​​entrance then​​ do ​a ​​game​ ​drive ​​en​​route​​ to ​​the ​​lodge.

Samburu ​​is ​​dry, ​​arid ​​land ​​with ​​rocky formations ​​surrounding​ ​the ​​Ewaso ​​Nyiro ​​River ​​which ​​runs​​ alongside ​​our ​​home​ ​for ​​the next ​​two ​​nights. ​​Lunch ​​then​​ relax ​​until ​​our ​​afternoon ​​game ​​drive. ​As you relax, you listen to the mellow sounds of running water beneath the shady trees. Ahhhh bliss...!

days.title: Samburu
days.description: Today ​​is ​​divided ​​into ​​morning ​​and ​​afternoon ​​game ​​drives ​​as ​​the ​​animals ​​tend ​​to ​​hide ​​from the​​ hot ​​mid​ day ​​sun. ​​In​​ Samburu ​​you ​​have ​​the ​​opportunity ​​to ​​see ​​grevy ​​zebra,​​ somali ostrich, ​​gerenuk,​​ vulturine ​​guinea ​​fowl ​​and ​​beisa​​ oryx ​​​​which ​​you ​​will ​​not ​​see ​​in ​​other places. ​​The ​​big ​​cats ​​prowl ​​here ​​too along with an abundance of bird life. Resident leopards can be seen just outside the lodge along with elephants.

days.title: Samburu – Aberdares
days.description:
We’re​​ on ​​the ​​road​​ again ​​and ​​make ​​our ​​way​​ to ​​the​​ Aberdares. ​​Our ​​lunch​​ today ​​will ​​be​​ at the ​​Aberdare ​​Country ​​Club;​​ a ​​sister ​​to ​​the ​​lodge​ ​where​ ​we​ ​will ​​stay​​ overnight. ​​We ​​will take ​​with ​​us ​​an ​​​​overnight ​​bag​ ​only​​.​​ Our​ ​main ​​luggage ​​will ​​be​ ​held ​​in ​​locked​ ​storage​ ​at the​​ Country​ ​Club ​​until ​​our ​​return​ ​tomorrow​ ​morning.

We​ ​board ​​a ​​bus ​​at ​​2.30pm​ ​which takes ​​us ​​45​ min​ ​to ​​our accommodation​​ within ​​the ​​Aberdare ​​National​ ​Park.​ ​Here​​ we​ ​will observe​ ​the ​​wildlife ​​at ​​close ​​range​ ​from​ ​one ​​of ​​four​ ​viewing ​​decks ​​or ​​a ​​cosy ​​lounge chair.​ ​​There is a dedicated photo hide on the lower deck where you are able to take close up uninhibited photography.

days.title: Aberdares – Elementaita
days.description:
After ​​breakfast ​​we ​​leave ​​the​​ Ark​​ Lodge​​ at ​​8am​​ on the bus​​ and​​ drive ​​out ​​of​​ the ​​park​​ and back ​​to​​ Aberdare​​ Country ​​Club. ​​If​​ we​​ get ​​lucky ​​and ​​see ​​animals​​ before​​ exiting ​​the ​​park we ​​will​​ make ​​a​​ stop.​​ Leopards ​​are ​​often ​​seen ​​at ​​this​​ time.

​​At ​​ACC​​ we​​ collect ​​our​ ​main luggage ​​and ​​get​​ on​​ our​​ way​​ to ​​our ​​next ​​destination.​​ Along​​ the​​ way ​​we​​ stop​​ at ​​the Equator ​​for ​​a​​ water ​​demonstration.​​ Morning ​​tea​​ stop​​ is​ ​at ​​Thompson​​ Falls ​​(named​​ after the​​ explorer ​​who​ ​discovered​ ​the​ ​Aberdare ​​Mountains​​ and​​ named​​ them​ ​after ​​his employer, ​​Lord​​ Aberdare;​ ​and​ ​who​​ has ​​the ​​Thompson ​​gazelle ​​named​ ​after ​​him). ​​Arrive at​​ Lake​ ​Elementaita​​ for ​​lunch. ​​Afternoon​ ​to​ ​relax​ ​and​ ​take ​​in ​​the ​​view ​​and ​​bird​​life.

days.title: Nakuru
days.description: Today ​​we ​​enjoy​​ a ​​full ​​day ​​game​​ drive ​​around ​​the ​​shores ​​of ​​Lake​​ Nakuru.​​ This ​​is ​​the only ​​place ​​you ​​will ​​be ​​able ​​to​​ see​​ the​​ endangered ​​Rothschild ​​giraffe ​​in ​​its ​​own​ ​habitat. White​​ and ​​black ​​rhino ​​also ​​live ​​here ​​along ​​with ​​many​​ other ​​wildlife ​​species. ​​We ​​take ​​a picnic ​​lunch​​ with​​ us​​ and​​ depart​​ the ​​park ​​in the ​​afternoon making our way back to Lake Elementaita and the relaxed atmosphere on the waters’ edge.

days.title: Elementaita – Maasai Mara
days.description:
We ​​leave ​​Elementaita​​ after ​​breakfast​​ and​​ make​​ our​​ way​​ to ​​the ​​world ​​famous​​ Maasai Mara​​ National​​ Reserve. ​​We ​​ stop​​ along ​​the ​​way​​ at Narok for​​ a​​ stretch ​​and coffee​​ break​​ before arriving​​ at ​​the ​​Reserve ​​for ​​a ​​late ​​lunch.​​ There’s time to chill out before your afternoon game drive going in search of wild things.

​​At 4pm we head off into the park to seek out lions, leopard, cheetah, elephants or anything out there that wants to be seen. As the sun sets, we’ll arrive back at our lodge for hot showers and dinner. Later, lay your head on your pillow and wait for the sounds of lions calling their pride or hyenas cackling as you drift off to sleep. Lala vizuri!

days.title: Maasai Mara
days.description:
For​​ the​​ next​​ four​​ days ​​we ​​leave ​​the​​ camp ​​after ​​breakfast​​ and​​ we​​ take ​​in ​​this ​​wonderful reserve​​ as ​​full​​ day ​​game ​​drives.​​ There ​​are ​​lots ​​of​​ areas ​​to ​​explore​​ and​​ find ​​the ​​big​​ cats and​​ other​​ animals ​​that ​​reside ​​here. ​​​​​Each day is spent full day game driving.

After a hearty breakfast to keep us going, we’ll explore the wonders of this park seeking out the best wildlife sightings for you. Each day is different and we’ll explore a different area each time. Our prime objective is to find the animals for you to enjoy. We’ll get in the best position possible for great photos without encroaching on the animals comfort and safety. We’ll make this your ultimate safari experience!  

At the end of each day it’s back to the lodge to chill out and remember the magic of your discovery.

title: Go East: Amboseli, Tsavo & Eastern Kenya Safari
content: NEW !! This is our latest safari itinerary inclusion packed with extra activities on top of our game drives. Twelve exciting days out in the wild but concentrating on the eastern parks in Kenya – Amboseli, Tsavo West, Taita Hills, Tsavo East, Lumo Conservancy and back to Amboseli. Add in night game drives, visit Shatani Lava Flow and Mzima Springs, underground photography hides, sundowners, bush dinner, bush breakfast, cultural village visit,overnight in a photography hide fully kitted out with beds and dedicated outdoor lighting on the waterhole. What an experience!
testimonial: Thank you for making our trip so special, I couldn't recommend (and I do often) your safari highly enough. Each day just got better than the last.

days.title: NAIROBI TO AMBOSELI(distance 240 km)
days.description:
We make our way out of the city and towards the acclaimed Amboseli NP, home of elephant herds and at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro -Africas’ highest mountain and the highest free standing mountain in the world. We relax after lunch before our afternoon game drive where we will go in search of big cats, elephants, zebras……….

MEAL PLAN: full board
ACCOMMODATION: SERENA AMBOSELI LODGE

days.title: AMBOSELI TO TSAVO WEST (distance 120 km )
days.description:
Once we enter the gate into Tsavo West NP, we begin our game drive towards our hotel. We will pass through the Shatani Lava Flow .The black lava is spread over 50 km. The name “Shetani,” which means “devil” in Swahili, is derived from the local belief that when the lava flow first occurred, around 500 years ago, it was the work of evil spirits due to the violent and fiery eruption.
We’ll also visit the Mzima Springs which produce an incredible 250 million litres of fresh water daily. We’ll do a guided walk which includes going into an underwater viewing chamber. After lunch at our lodge, and rest time, we will head off on our afternoon game drive.

MEAL PLAN: full board
ACCOMMODATION: KILAGUNI SERENA LODGE

days.title: TSAVO WEST TO TAITA HILLS(distance 90 km )
days.description:
The private Taita Hills Wildlife Sanctuary is our next destination. Our accommodation is famed for being one of the worlds’ most photographed lodges. The sanctuary is home to more than 50 different species of animals and over 300 different species of birds. There is also a tunnel that leads to an “all day” underground photo hide where all manner of animals come to drink at the well- positioned waterhole outside it. Today we will do both an afternoon and night game drive. Night drives provide an opportunity of seeing animals not encountered during the day eg/ striped hyena, mongoose, civet, genet, porcupine and bushbaby. And maybe get lucky to see predators hunting.

MEAL PLAN: full board
ACCOMMODATION : SAROVA SALT LICK LODGE

days.title: FULL DAY TAITA HILLS
days.description:
Todays activities include both a morning and afternoon game drive. This will provide an ideal opportunity to see the abundant wildlife that resides here. In the latter part of our afternoon drive we will head to one of the four bush activity venues within the sanctuary for sundowners (drinks as the sun sets) overlooking the magnificent views of the Taita Hills. This is followed by the awesome experience of dinner out in the bush. After dinner we can do a night drive back to our lodge.

MEAL PLAN: full board
SAROVA SALT LICK LODGE

days.title: TAITA HILLS TO TSAVO EAST(distance 90 km )
days.description:
We leave after breakfast and head to our next location - Tsavo East NP, famous for its large herds of red- dusted elephants. This is the largest, and oldest, National Park in Kenya covering almost 14,000 sq km. It’s also the home of the longest plateau in the world - Yatta Plateau. There is abundant wildlife and birds in this park. The critically endangered Hirola Antelope resides here but it’s not easy to find them.

MEAL PLAN : full board
ACCOMMODATION : ASHNIL ARUBA LODGE

days.title: FULL DAY TSAVO EAST
days.description:
After breakfast we’ll head off, with picnic lunch, for a full day game drive. Depending on time and what we see, morning tea will be on top of Mudanda Rock. Mudanda rock dates back to the Precambrian era, it is said to have been used for drying strips of meat and as a lookout in the past by the local tribes. Today it serves as one of the view spots with the top giving 360deg views of the park.

MEAL PLAN: full board
ACCOMMODATION : ASHNIL ARUBA LODGE

days.title: TSAVO EAST TO LUMO CONSERVANCY(distance 100 km )
days.description:
We’ll arrive at our next destination in plenty of time for lunch, rest, then an afternoon game drive to explore this region. This conservancy is very community minded and has made tangible improvements to the lives of the local people with investments in infrastructure, education and healthcare. It’s also an inspiring example of how people and wildlife can co-exist. Afternoon game drive and night game drive for those that
want. ( night game drive to be organised and paid for at the lodge)

MEAL PLAN : full board
ACCOMMODATION : SOROI CHEETAH TENTED CAMP

days.title: FULL DAY LUMO
days.description:
We’ll leave the lodge at 6.30am for a morning game drive as the sun rises. This is a beautiful, peaceful time of the day when the air is cool and the predators are still active.
This will culminate with a bush breakfast somewhere out in the wild. Our chef will prepare a cooked breakfast while we relax and soak up the atmosphere of the bush.
This will be followed by a cultural visit to a local village. We will enter a typical ethnic home to see how they live. Other activities may include milking a cow, harvesting vegetables, traditional cooking practices, making sisal ropes, basket weaving, dancing/drumming, learning about medicinal plants. We may be driven to explore skull caves and untouched rainforest where it is possible to see rare birds and butterflies that only exist here. This will be a tailored visit to suit the group size, ensuring a personalized and engaging experience.
Lunch will be back at the lodge followed by rest time. 15 minutes from the lodge is a dedicated underground, photographic hide. It is airconditioned, wifi, mini bar and tea/coffee facilities, 4 bunk beds, toilet, adjustable exterior lights and one way glass so the animals are unaware we’re there. For those that want, and dependant on numbers, we have an overnight stay at the hide.

MEAL PLAN: full board
ACCOMMODATION : SOROI CHEETAH TENTED CAMP

days.title: FULL DAY LUMO
days.description:
Today we concentrate on the animals and birds with both a morning and afternoon game drive. We’ll do a PM at the photographic hide from sunset. This is the best time to get low and close to the animals as they come in to drink after a hot day.

MEAL PLAN : full board
ACCOMMODATION : SOROI CHEETAH TENTED CAMP

days.title: LUMO TO AMBOSELI(distance 180 km )
days.description:
After breakfast we leave Lumo Conservancy and head back to Amboseli in time for our lunch at the lodge. Our accommodation is just outside the park gates. Afternoon game drive.

MEAL PLAN : full board
ACCOMMODATION : SENTRIM AMBOSELI

days.title: FULL DAY AMBOSELI
days.description:
After breakfast, and with our picnic lunch, we enter the park for a full day exploring the swamps and observing the habits of the elephants, buffaloes, zebras and even lions and cheetahs if we’re lucky. We’ll head to Observation Hill to get a birds eye view of the landscape around us and Mt Kilimanjaro in all her glory. There’s an abundance of bird life in the wet areas with massive numbers of flamingoes.

MEAL PLAN : full board
ACCOMMODATION : SENTRIM AMBOSELI

days.title: AMBOSELI TO NAIROBI(distance 240 km )
days.description:
We’re back on the road again after breakfast heading to the city life of Nairobi. Arrive for lunch (own cost). Our overnight stay is amongst the beautiful, manicured gardens of our hotel which is set on 50 acres. Relax, swim, wander the gardens. It doesn’t end there though because tonight we enjoy a meal of a vast array of bbq meats, sizzling hot and presented on skewers and carved at our table within the atmosphere of the Nyama Choma Ranch. Live music emanates while we dine. This restaurant has its own stage, state -of-the-art lighting and sound system which will be the backdrop for a 45 minute extravaganza show of dance,brilliant costumes and acrobatics by world renown Safari Catz- a team of professionally trained and choreographed dancers.
This ends our time together on safari.

MEAL PLAN : dinner and breakfast
ACCOMMODATION : SAFARI PARK HOTEL

DEPARTURE DAY 
We will transfer you from Safari Park Hotel to the airport for your onward flight. If your flight is at night there are options available within the city limits to do extra activities (at own cost) before heading to the airport. Asante sana (thankyou very much) Karibu tena (welcome again)

title: Black Leopard Safari - In Search of Giza, Kenya's Melanistic Leopard
content: NEW !! Six awesome days of adventure concentrating on seeing the rare black leopard! We are offering you the chance of a lifetime ! Being in the presence of one of the rarest creatures on Earth - the melanistic (black) leopard is something you will always remember. The setting is in one of the remotest regions in Kenya so the numbers of humans around on any given day is very restricted. As are vehicle numbers. The only drivers permitted to do game drives here are the drivers employed by the camp. And there are strict rules around time spent with the cat to ensure she is not in any way stressed. So, this is a completely different experience but one not to be missed !! Time spent within the camp area has a family feel to it where all guests sit around one big table to eat delicious food . Pre dinner the fire pit is where we can meet people from other parts of the world and share the days' events. It's a small camp dedicated to togetherness. Just an awesome place to stay !!
testimonial: For me, my heart sang every day just to be amongst beautiful people, new friends and of course to have the privilege of spending time with the most beautiful animals on this earth in their kingdom, long may they survive.

days.title: Laikipia Wilderness Camp
days.description:
Laikipia Wilderness Camp is all about adventure. It stands in one of the remotest regions of Kenya. It has become famous for sightings of the melastic (black) leopard which has her territory right around the camp. These cats are extremely rare and you will be very privileged to see one. The most famous of all, Giza, was born and raised less than 1km from camp and is especially relaxed around the vehicles. She is a wild animal and can be unpredictable so there is, as with all wild animals, no guarantee of seeing her. Although, with a six day safari, the chances are favourable. There are at least three other black leopards seen in this conservancy.
The number of vehicles (3) and the time spent with Giza is limited.
We will, therefore, have a private Black Leopard Vehicle which will give us priority. The leopard is respected at all sightings and game drives seeing her can be ceased if it is seen she is under any stress or needs to hunt. Game drives to see her are restricted between 6am and 8 pm so that during night hours she is left to be a leopard.

days.title: The daily schedule
days.description:
The daily schedule is flexible but an early start is encouraged. Tea/coffee will be served at the main tent at approx 5.30- 6am along with a light breakfast. We head out as the sun rises. Morning coffee and a muffin are served somewhere out in the bush mid morning before returning to camp around 11am for a scrummy lunch.
Sometimes lunch may be served out in the wild. The afternoon is the hottest time of the day - even for the animals, who will hide in the shade- so we will stay in camp to rest until 4pm before enjoying a freshly baked cake with tea/coffee before heading off again for the afternoon/night game drive. Night game drives can also unearth other unusual species such as striped hyena, aardwolf, aardvark, zorilla, porcupine, genet and other small mammals.
Sundowners are served in the vehicle as we wait for Giza to appear. We round off our day at 8 pm, back at camp, with drinks and chat around the fire pit before a delicious dinner is served at the communal table. It’s a real family atmosphere. Or sometimes we will stay out and enjoy a bush dinner around a fire pit in the wilderness. Lastly, it’s time for bed while listening to the sounds of the night time wildlife.

days.title: Game drives
days.description: Game drives are the best way to cover ground and see the most wildlife. This area has excellent populations of elephant, reticulated giraffe, Grevy’s zebra, common zebra, warthog, buffalo, hippo and many antelope species. Lions, leopards and wild dogs are also often seen. We have 10 game drives within these six days at Laikipia Wilderness Camp before we head back to Nairobi and to your post safari accommodation. Departure We will transfer you from Holiday Inn Hotel to the airport for your onward flight. If your flight is at night there are options available within the city limits to do extra activities (at own cost) before heading to the airport. Asante sana (thankyou very much) Karibu tena (welcome again).
